references.text: This parallel highlights the irony that the people use identical sacrificial liturgy both to resolve a man-made crisis and to worship an idol, which calls for a theological assessment of the motivation behind the ritual.
A strong thematic parallel where both texts describe building an altar and offering burnt offerings and peace offerings as a turning point from God's judgment to grace after a conflict.
A clear theological parallel where both texts show how building an altar and offering burnt offerings and peace offerings serves as a means to stop God's judgment and bring peace.

This connection highlights how the historical event in Judges 21 attempts to implement the principle in Exodus 24 of offering sacrifices at every place where God's name is remembered, even in chaotic times.
